text: less freaking out

Ich habe durch die Erfahrung gelernt, dass ich mich in Krisen nicht verstecken muss. Früher habe ich mich in schwierigen Zeiten völlig zurückgezogen, das Handy ausgeschaltet und niemanden gesehen. In der Erfahrung habe ich gespürt, wie sehr mich meine Freunde lieben und wie gerne sie für mich da wären. Als im letzten Jahr mein Vater gestorben ist, habe ich zum ersten Mal zugelassen, dass andere mich trösten. Meine beste Freundin ist für ein Wochenende zu mir gekommen, wir haben zusammen geweint und gelacht. Das hat mir unglaublich geholfen. Ich glaube, ohne die Erfahrung hätte ich das nicht gekonnt. Ich gehe heute mit Belastungen viel offener um und rede auch mit Kollegen darüber, wenn es mir nicht gut geht.
I'm not sure the experience had any effect on that. Life has been relatively calm since then.
I've stopped trying to be strong all the time. When something hard happens, I let myself be affected by it, and then I deal with it. It's healthier than pretending.
Ich bin gelassener geworden, besonders bei Kleinigkeiten, die mich früher wahnsinnig gemacht haben, wie Verspätungen der Bahn oder unfreundliche Menschen.

The experience made me understand how much my childhood still affects me. I grew up with a mother who had borderline personality disorder, and I learned to anticipate every mood change and fix it before it escalated. I've carried that into adulthood. Whenever there's tension, at work, with my partner, with friends, I go into hypervigilant fixing mode, and it exhausts me. During the experience I saw this whole pattern laid out before me, and I saw the little girl who was always on alert. I felt so much compassion for her. Since then, I can sometimes catch myself going into fixing mode and stop. I remind myself that I'm not responsible for everyone's emotions. It's still hard, and I fall back into old habits, but I'm much more aware, and I've started working on this with a therapist who specialises in childhood trauma.
I can handle stressful situations a lot better than I used to. I'm more patient and less reactive. When something goes wrong, I take a breath and think about what to do next.
Kann ich nicht beurteilen.

Before my experience I was a very anxious person, and stressful events would trigger days of rumination. I'd replay conversations, imagine worst-case scenarios, and lose sleep. The experience was in a beautiful setting in the mountains with a small group, and for me it was mostly a very loving, heart-opening experience. I felt deeply connected to the other participants and to nature. I think what changed is that I now have a felt sense of being part of something larger and safe. When I'm stressed now, I can tap into that feeling, sometimes by going outside and looking at the sky or the trees. The rumination still happens, but it's much shorter. I also reach out to friends more instead of carrying everything alone in my head.
I don't think I handle stress differently. Maybe I'm a bit more reflective.
Ich habe gelernt, dass ich mich nicht für alles verantwortlich fühlen muss. Das hat mir viel Stress genommen, vor allem in meiner Familie.

I'm a teacher and the experience changed how I deal with difficult students and parents. I used to take everything personally and get defensive. During the experience I felt a deep compassion for everyone, including the people who make my life hard. Now when a student acts out or a parent complains, I try to see what's going on for them. It doesn't mean I don't set boundaries, but I don't feel attacked anymore, and I'm much calmer at work. My headteacher has commented on it.
More patient

Die Erfahrung hat mir gezeigt, wie sehr ich mich von meinen Ängsten habe leiten lassen. Ich hatte immer Angst vor dem Scheitern, vor Ablehnung, vor Veränderung. In der Erfahrung habe ich diese Ängste wie Wolken gesehen, die vorbeiziehen, und gemerkt, dass dahinter immer der blaue Himmel ist. Seitdem kann ich in belastenden Situationen eher innehalten und mich daran erinnern, dass auch diese Angst vorbeigehen wird. Das hat mir zum Beispiel geholfen, als ich mich selbstständig gemacht habe, was mit sehr viel Unsicherheit verbunden war. Ich hatte zwar Angst, aber ich habe es trotzdem gemacht.
I've stopped bottling things up. When something is bothering me, I talk about it. That's made a huge difference in my stress levels.

Honestly, for the first months it was harder to deal with stress. Old stuff I had pushed away kept surfacing at the worst moments. For a while I was very emotional and couldn't function well at work. But over time, as I processed it all, I became much stronger. Now I handle stress better than I ever have, because I'm not using all my energy to keep things down.

Seit der Erfahrung habe ich angefangen, regelmäßig zu meditieren und Atemübungen zu machen. Wenn ich gestresst bin, nehme ich mir ein paar Minuten, um bewusst zu atmen. Das hilft mir sehr, wieder klar zu denken.

I've become way less anxious in social situations, which were always my biggest source of stress. I go to parties now and actually have fun. I talk to strangers. I even gave a toast at my brother's wedding, which a few years ago would have been unthinkable.

Since the experience I deal with stress by asking myself what I can control and what I can't. If I can control it, I take action. If I can't, I try to let it go. This simple question has changed my life. During the experience I saw how much energy I waste on things I can't change, like other people's opinions, the economy, the weather. Now I'm more focused and less anxious. It's helped me through a difficult job search and a health scare.
Kein Unterschied bemerkbar
I'm more resilient because I have more self-compassion. When I mess up I don't punish myself for days.

I deal with stress much better since I stopped drinking, which was a direct result of the experience. During the trip I saw my drinking very clearly, how it was making everything worse, my anxiety, my relationships, my health. I stopped the next week and haven't had a drink since, 2 years now. When I'm stressed now I go running or call a friend from AA. I feel things more, which is hard sometimes, but I deal with problems instead of drowning them.
Ich bin entspannter und kann besser loslassen. Wenn etwas nicht so läuft wie geplant, ärgere ich mich nicht mehr so lange darüber.
Not much changed

The experience helped me reframe my anxiety disorder. I've had panic attacks since childhood, and every stressful situation used to trigger one. During the experience I had what felt like the worst panic attack of my life, and then it transformed into this incredible bliss. I learned that panic is just energy, and that on the other side of it there can be something good. I'm not saying I enjoy panic attacks now, but I'm not afraid of them anymore. And since I'm not afraid, they come less often. Stressful events still make me anxious, but I don't spiral like I used to. I've also learned breathing techniques that help me ride out the anxiety when it comes.
Ich nehme die Dinge, wie sie kommen. Das war früher nicht so.
I trust that things will work out. When I'm stressed I remind myself that I've always found a way so far.

I'm not a very spiritual person, but the experience gave me a sense of perspective that has stayed with me. When something stressful happens, I think about how small it is compared to the universe, and that makes it easier to deal with. I know that sounds a bit clichéd, but it really works for me. I also think I'm better at prioritising, because I have a clearer sense of what's really important.

Ich bin nach der Erfahrung mit Stress anders umgegangen, weil ich gemerkt habe, dass ich viel zu viel im Kopf bin. Ich habe angefangen, mehr auf meinen Körper zu achten, mache Sport und gehe viel spazieren. Ich merke, dass ich dadurch stressresistenter geworden bin. Früher habe ich versucht, alle Probleme durch Nachdenken zu lösen, und bin dabei oft in Grübelschleifen geraten. Heute weiß ich, dass Bewegung mir oft mehr hilft als Nachdenken.
Less stressed in general and better at switching off after work.

For me, the main change is that I don't feel so alone when things are hard. During the experience I felt my late grandmother's presence very strongly, and I had the sense that she's still with me. I know that might sound strange, and I'm not sure what I believe about it, but it comforts me. When I'm going through something stressful, I talk to her in my head, and it calms me down. It's like I have an ally. I've also become much closer to my mother since then, because we've talked a lot about grandma and about our own relationship, and she's now someone I can turn to when I'm struggling.
Ich bin ruhiger und lasse mich nicht so schnell aus der Fassung bringen.
I'm more aware of my patterns and I try to respond rather than react. It's still work in progress.

After the experience I was quite unstable for a while. I had trouble sleeping and I was more easily overwhelmed by stress. That lasted about six months. Since then I've been fine, but I can't say it made me better at handling stress. If anything I'm more cautious now.

Ich habe gelernt, mich in schwierigen Situationen selbst zu beruhigen, ähnlich wie ich es in der Erfahrung getan habe, als ich große Angst hatte. Ich lege dann eine Hand auf mein Herz und sage mir, dass alles gut wird. Das klingt einfach, hilft aber erstaunlich gut.

I'm better at accepting that some things in life are just painful, and that I can't fix everything. I used to exhaust myself trying to solve every problem, my own and everyone else's. Now I can sit with discomfort.

I've become much more comfortable with conflict. I used to avoid it at all costs and then explode later. Now I address things early, calmly and directly. My relationships are healthier for it, and I'm less stressed because things don't build up.
Mehr Ruhe, weniger Hektik

I feel more able to deal with stress because I have a better sense of my own worth. I used to think I had to earn my place in the world by being useful, and every failure felt like a threat. During the experience I felt deeply loved, just for existing, and that has changed the foundation of how I see myself. When something goes wrong now, it's just something that went wrong, not proof that I'm worthless.
About the same, maybe a bit better
